verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Attio documents an official MCP server at attio.com/mcp. Attio's docs also say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools to search, update and manage their workspace, which delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: documented MCP setup/auth details, list of exposed tools/capabilities, transport/endpoint specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://attio.com/mcp
